title: **Wait for registry availability in the npm
notes: quality-config 0.15.0 was visible in npm metadata or installable; it
became available a few minutes later. Smallest next step: add pnpm's
supported `--publish-wait-timeout 600000` to the workflow publish command,
so success also verifies metadata and tarball availability.
result: The manual publish command now waits up to 600000 milliseconds for exact-version registry metadata and tarball availability. It preserves OIDC, ignore-scripts and the sole workflow_dispatch trigger; a comment warns that a timeout may follow an accepted upload.
evidence: actionlint .github/workflows/publish.yml and pnpm exec prettier --check .github/workflows/publish.yml exit 0. Structural comparison proves triggers/permissions unchanged and the exact wait flag occurs once. Official pinned pnpm 12.9.1 implementation supports the flag. No publication, workflow dispatch or retry was executed.
